# A tour of the window

The Mini-Me window has **three main areas** and a bar along the bottom.

![The Mini-Me window](images/window-overview.png)

## ① The left sidebar — your conversations

This is where you find your work.

- **Conversations** tab: every conversation you have started, newest first.
- **Projects** tab: groups of conversations about the same topic. See
  [Projects and conversations](projects.qmd).
- **Search box**: type a few words to find an old conversation.
- **+ button**: start a **New conversation** or a **New project…**

You can hide or show the sidebar with the button at its top, and make it wider or narrower by
dragging its edge.

## ② The chat — where you talk to Mini-Me

This is the main area.

- At the **bottom** is the box where you type your question.
- Above it, Mini-Me's answers appear as they are written, like a chat.
- Each answer shows **which specialist** did the work and how many **steps** it took. Click the
  steps to see what happened.

See [Asking questions](asking-questions.qmd).

## ③ The Pinboard — your results

The panel on the right collects everything this conversation has produced, so you don't have to
scroll through the chat to find it:

- **Mission** — what the project is about.
- **Completed** and **Pending** — work already done and work still to do.
- **Plan** — the steps Mini-Me is following for the current question.
- **Background Jobs** — long tasks that are still running.
- **Files** — charts, cleaned data, reports and other files.
- **Sources** — the papers and references that were used.

You can hide or show the Pinboard with the button at its top. See
[Your results](results.qmd).

## ④ The bottom bar

The thin bar at the bottom of the window shows short status messages (for example, "sign-in
link copied"), reminds you that **`Ctrl+P` opens the command list**, and shows the update button
when a new version is ready.

## The command list (`Ctrl+P`)

Press **`Ctrl+P`** at any time to open a search box with everything Mini-Me can do — for
example *Settings*, *Save the latest report as a PDF*, or *Restart the backend*. Start typing,
use the arrow keys to pick one, and press **Enter**.

![The command list](images/window-command-palette.png)

See [Keyboard shortcuts](shortcuts.qmd) for the full list.
